items.title: Harold Dejan Interview, 1960-11-18
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] No we missed that talk to him I've been talking about. Robinson. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Yeah, she gave them good interviews because she remember all them old times and remember the names and everything so good. That's good. Because her son told me that it surprised him. She remember like Edna used to play piano, Edna Francis, Alvin Francis' wife was playing trumpet, the one called Cuckoo, I never didn't know he was right, and Big Ike was playing trombone, Big Ike was on Clairvon, he's not playing anymore.
No we missed that talk to him I've been talking about. Robinson.
Yeah. And Benny Benoit was playing banjo, well I see him every day, he can't talk too well, but I told him, we might interview him one time, that's Saiz Bredelaw.
